## zipzi.values.SceneBinding

```python
class SceneBinding(Value)
```

Ordinary parameter grid driving a Warp, Rotation or Part track.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `str` | Required | Stable document object ID used by references; it is distinct from the exported runtime_id. |
| `axes` | `tuple[BindingAxis, ...]` | Required | Ordered parameter axes; keyform coordinates follow this order and samples retain their<br>own identities. |
| `track` | `SceneTrack` | Required | Typed Warp, Rotation or Part keyform track; the track target determines shape<br>interpretation. |
